🔥 बॉलीवुड में काम के घंटों पर चल रही बहस में अब आलिया भट्ट भी कूद पड़ी हैं! 🎬

TIME magazine की TIME100 Next India लिस्ट के कवर पर नजर आईं आलिया भट्ट ने दीपिका पादुकोण की 8 घंटे काम की मांग का खुलकर समर्थन किया है। रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, 2025 में मां बनने के बाद दीपिका ने अपनी फिल्मों के लिए 8 घंटे की शिफ्ट मांगी थी, जिसके बाद उनके Spirit और Kalki 2898 AD Part 2 जैसी फिल्मों से बाहर होने की खबरें आई थीं।

अब आलिया भट्ट ने इंटरव्यू में कहा कि काम के घंटे तय होने से काम बेहतर होता है और अपनी सीमाएं तय करने पर किसी को नौकरी खोने का डर नहीं होना चाहिए। इसके साथ ही आलिया ने फिल्म सेट पर महिला कलाकारों और क्रू के लिए साफ टॉयलेट की बेसिक सुविधा की मांग भी उठाई है।

वर्कफ्रंट पर आलिया जल्द ही Love & War में दिखेंगी, वहीं दीपिका की फिल्म King दिसंबर 2026 में रिलीज होगी। 🌟

क्या आपको लगता है कि फिल्म सेट्स पर काम के घंटे और बुनियादी सुविधाएं तय होनी चाहिए? कमेंट्स में बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Alia Bhatt backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour work shift demand, calls for better facilities and clean toilets for women on sets
ctx.summary: Alia Bhatt called for fair working hours, adding that people shouldn’t be afraid of losing employment when they set those boundaries
ctx.text:
Bollywood actor Deepika Padukone 's reported exits from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit and Kalki 2898 AD Part 2 over her reported demand for an eight-hour workday sparked a discussion about work-life balance for actors and technicians. Several actors, including Neha Dhupia , Kareena Kapoor, Ananya Panday and others, backed her. Now, Alia Bhatt has also supported Deepika's demand and revealed what else she believes needs to change in the industry.
Alia featured on the cover of TIME magazine's TIME100 Next India list. In an interview with the magazine, Alia revealed that she stands firmly with Deepika, who recently sparked a debate over Bollywood's culture of long working hours. She said, "I’ve been lucky that all my producers have been extremely accommodating, but this needs a rethink. It cannot be arbitrary. Fair working hours make the work more efficient, and people shouldn’t be afraid of losing employment when they set those boundaries."
Alia revealed that there's another reform she wants to bring to her sets: clean toilets for female artistes. She said, “It’s not really asking for the sun and the moon but something so basic, so essential. A woman being able to use a clean bathroom on a film set should not be a conversation in 2026. I want to ensure—on a systemic level—that this becomes a norm for the entire crew and not just the top talent.”
The TIME100 Next India list recognises emerging leaders whose work, ideas and vision are shaping the country's future. The list also features Vedang Raina, Parvathy Thiruvothu, Vicky Kaushal, Payal Kapadia, Aryan Khan, Faheem Abdullah, Anirudh Ravichander, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Kani Kusruti, among others.
Bollywood actor Deepika Padukone sparked a major debate in the Hindi film industry in 2025 after reports emerged that she had requested an eight-hour workday for her upcoming projects after embracing motherhood. The issue came into focus following reports of her exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit, starring Prabhas, and later Kalki 2898 AD Part 2.
Deepika later defended her stance, pointing out that several male superstars had been following eight-hour shifts for years without facing any questions. She also highlighted the unorganised nature of the film industry and called for better working conditions for everyone, including crew members.
Alia will next be seen in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War. The film marks her second collaboration with the filmmaker and also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal in lead roles. It is scheduled to release in theatres in January 2027.
Deepika, on the other hand, is awaiting the release of King. Helmed by Siddharth Anand, the film also stars Shah Rukh Khan, Abhishek Bachchan and Suhana Khan in lead roles. Raghav Juyal, Arshad Warsi, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat and others are also part of the ensemble cast. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on December 24, 2026.
